title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-12 08:32:07 最新章节：第一卷 第495章 为灵尊尽忠的时候到了
content_zh:
“哗啦啦……”
寒潭上雾气缭绕，潭水轻扬，叮咚作响，一道白皙剔透，玲珑浮突，成熟动人的身影若隐若现。
“啧啧！”
“险啊险！”
“妙啊妙！”
“仙肌玉骨，灵光自照，道痕天成……真乃世间第一等的无上宝体啊！”
寒潭边，灌木丛窸窣一动，钻出一颗白发苍苍的脑袋，直勾勾盯着潭中撩人身影，两眼冒光，嘴里念念有词。
他身后。
还蹲了个少年。
少年背对着他，嘴里叼了根草茎，对背后的美景视若无睹，反而有些神游天外，又一次被老头子强拉过来放风的他，当下很是忧郁。
“老头子，我又做梦了。”
“……”
“还是那个梦。”
“……”
“还是那个棺材，还是那几个人，他们借走了我的东西，也没说还不还。”
“……”
这种话，老头子似乎听过了八百遍，也懒得搭理，眼睛依旧直勾勾盯着前面。
少年突然有些恼火。
“还有个漂亮姐姐！”
“恩？”

老头子耳朵一支棱，突然回头，压低了声音肃然道：“有多漂亮？”
“比李婶漂亮多了！”
少年压低声音，神秘兮兮道：“我从没见过这么漂亮的女人！”
老头子嗤笑。
“小毛娃娃懂个屁！这世间的女子有一个算一个，任你绝代风华，倾国倾城，又哪里比得上李家妹子的风韵？李家妹子的味道？”
少年撇撇嘴。
李婶固然是老头子你的梦中情人，可那位仙子姐姐……也是真的很漂亮啊！
也懒得反驳。
他继续碎碎念。
“她比那几个人讲究多了，虽然借了我的东西，可也还了我一件东西。”
“还的什么？”
老头子从背后伸出手：“拿来让老头子我看看！”
少年突然有些沮丧，低下了头，当下更忧郁了。
“我看不清……”
“我也找不到……”
“梦里的事，别当真！”
老头子敷衍了一句，又是对着那副心目中的无上宝体观摩了起来。
犹豫了好一会。
content_en:
"Crash..."
The mist is lingering on the cold pool, the water in the pool is floating gently, and there is a tinkling sound. A white and clear, exquisite and floating figure is looming, and the mature and moving figure is looming.
"Tsk tsk!"
"Danger! Danger!"
"Wonderful!"
"Immortal muscles and jade bones, the spiritual light illuminates itself, and the Dao marks are made in heaven... It is truly the first-class supreme treasure body in the world!"
Beside the cold pool, the bushes rustled, and a white-haired head emerged. It stared directly at the sultry figure in the pool, with eyes shining and words murmuring in its mouth.
behind him.
There was also a boy squatting.
The young man turned his back to him, holding a grass stem in his mouth. He turned a blind eye to the beautiful scenery behind him. Instead, he was a little distracted. He was once again forced to come over by the old man to let him have fun. He was very melancholy at the moment.
"Old man, I'm dreaming again."
"..."
"It's still the same dream."
"..."
"It's the same coffin and the same people. They borrowed my things and didn't say they would return them."
"..."
The old man seemed to have heard this kind of thing eight hundred times, but he didn't bother to pay attention to it. He still stared straight ahead.
The young man suddenly became angry.
"And a beautiful sister!"
"Huh?"
The old man's ears twitched, he suddenly turned around, lowered his voice and said solemnly: "How beautiful is she?"
"Much more beautiful than Aunt Li!"
The young man lowered his voice and said mysteriously: "I have never seen such a beautiful woman!"
The old man sneered.
"Little Mao Doll knows nothing! There are many women in this world. No matter how beautiful you are, you can conquer the country and conquer the city. How can you compare with the charm of the girls from the Li family? The taste of the girls from the Li family?"
The young man curled his lips.
Although Aunt Li is your dream girl, old man, but that fairy sister... is also really beautiful!
Not too lazy to refute.
He continued to ramble.
"She is much more particular than those people. Although she borrowed something from me, she also gave me something back."
"What's the return?"
The old man stretched out his hand from behind: "Bring it to me, old man, and let me see!"
The young man suddenly felt depressed and lowered his head, becoming even more melancholy at the moment.
"I can't see clearly..."
"I can't find it either..."
"Don't take things in your dreams seriously!"
The old man said something perfunctory, and then began to observe the supreme treasure body in his mind.
I hesitated for a while.
